map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：2×√(effD×t×3600)×erfInv(ra: Core formula (over the input variables): 2×√(effD×t×3600)×erfInv(ratio); D0×Math.exp(-Q÷(R×Tk)); 2.0e-5
map.表面碳浓度服从半无限体扩散方程，碳浓度 C(x,t)/C0 = erf(x/(2: the surface carbon concentration follows the semi-infinite body diffusion equation, with carbon concentration C(x,t)/C0 = erf(x/(2√(D·t))).
map.x = 2·√(D·t)·erf⁻¹(Cs/C0)，D 为碳在奥氏体中扩散系数。: x = 2·√(D·t)·erf⁻¹(Cs/C0), where D is the diffusion coefficient of carbon in austenite.
map.空气取满脱碳(表面C≈0)，弱脱碳折减0.6，保护气氛折减0.1。: Air uses full decarburisation (surface C≈0), a weak decarburising atmosphere is reduced to 0.6 and a protective atmosphere to 0.1.
map.注：为工程估算，实际脱碳受合金元素、晶粒、氧分压等多因素影响。: Note: this is an engineering estimate; actual decarburisation is affected by many factors such as alloying elements, grain size and oxygen partial pressure.
map.按加热温度、保温时间与气氛估算钢材表面脱碳层深度，判定加工余量是否足够。: Estimate the depth of the decarburised layer on the steel surface from heating temperature, holding time and atmosphere, to judge whether the machining allowance is sufficient.
map.用扩散方程定量给出 C(x,t)/C0 沿层深分布，定位碳含量跌至某阈值的深度。: Use the diffusion equation to give the C(x,t)/C0 distribution quantitatively along the depth, locating the depth at which carbon content falls to a threshold.
map.对比空气/弱氧化/保护气氛的修正系数，优化加热制度。: Compare the correction factors for air, weakly oxidising and protective atmospheres to optimise the heating schedule.
map.表层碳浓度分布 C(x,t)/C0 = erf( x / (2√(D·t)) ): Surface carbon concentration distribution C(x,t)/C0 = erf( x / (2√(D·t)) ), depth x = 2√(D·t)·erf⁻¹(Cs/C0). Diffusion coefficient D = D0·exp(−Q/(R·T)), D0=2.0×10⁻⁵ m²/s, Q=142 kJ/mol, R=8.314. Atmosphere correction factors: air 1.0, weakly oxidising 0.6, neutral or protective 0.1.

Switching to a protective atmosphere (×0.1) reduces the depth to about 0.04 mm.
map.脱碳层多深要留余量？: How much allowance for the decarburised layer?
map.以最终硬度/渗层要求定；若脱碳 0.4 mm，粗加工留量应大于该值并在精加工去除: Set it from the final hardness or case depth requirement. If decarburisation is 0.4 mm, rough machining should leave more than that and remove it in finish machining, otherwise the soft surface layer affects wear resistance and fatigue.
map.温度影响为何这么大？: Why does temperature matter so much?
map.D 随温度指数增长，温度每升约 50–100℃ 扩散系数可成倍增加，故控制加热温: D grows exponentially with temperature, so raising the temperature by about 50 to 100°C can double the diffusion coefficient. Controlling heating temperature and dwell time is therefore the core of suppressing decarburisation.
